text:
Why did the largest crypto hack on record not break the market?

The Binance exploit was $6.3bn. Our view is that the headline overstates the damage. Circle, Tether and other issuers froze approximately $2.8bn of stolen assets quickly, and Binance has reportedly replenished affected funds from its own reserves and insurance fund. Transparent onchain infrastructure made the assets traceable, which is not possible with a bank wire.

For allocators, the useful point is the pattern. The size of an incident matters less than how quickly it can be contained, and that depends on infrastructure and counterparties rather than on the headline number.

On our side, Re7 Labs curated vaults had no exposure to the event, across all chains and platforms.

The full note is in this week's Weekly: [link]
